ai-and-ml.name: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
ai-and-ml.tagline: Shaping Intelligent Minds for a Smarter Tomorrow
ai-and-ml.overview:
Established in 2020 with an initial intake of 60 students, the Department of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning was founded to offer quality education in one of the fastest-growing areas of technology. The department provides a strong academic foundation in AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, and related fields through a curriculum that blends theoretical knowledge with practical learning.

The department emphasizes innovation, critical thinking, and hands-on experience through modern laboratories, research activities, and industry-oriented initiatives. Faculty members are actively involved in research and guide doctoral scholars, fostering a vibrant culture of learning and knowledge creation.

Students are encouraged to participate in research projects, internships, hackathons, and technical events that enhance their professional skills and problem-solving abilities. Through academic excellence, ethical values, and experiential learning, the department strives to nurture competent, innovative, and socially responsible professionals ready to contribute to the evolving technological landscape.

associations.name: Association of Intelligent Minds (AIM)
associations.about:
The Association of Intelligent Minds (AIM) is the official student association of the Department of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Basaveshwar Engineering College, Bagalkot. The association serves as a vibrant platform for fostering technical excellence, innovation, research, entrepreneurship, leadership, and collaborative learning among students.

AIM organizes a wide range of academic, technical, and co-curricular activities, including expert talks, workshops, hackathons, coding competitions, project exhibitions, paper presentations, industrial visits, student development programmes (SDPs), innovation challenges, startup initiatives, and community outreach activities. The association encourages students to apply AI and ML technologies to solve real-world problems in domains such as healthcare, agriculture, smart cities, robotics, and intelligent automation.

Through active engagement with industry experts, alumni, research organizations, and professional bodies, AIM bridges the gap between academia and industry, preparing students for successful careers in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, and emerging technologies. By promoting creativity, teamwork, lifelong learning, and ethical innovation, the Association of Intelligent Minds strives to develop technically competent, socially responsible, and globally competitive AI professionals.

automobile-engg.tagline: Academic excellence in automobile engineering through quality education and a research mindset for a sustainable future.
automobile-engg.overview: BVV Sangha's Basaveshwar Engineering College re-established the Automobile Engineering department in 2024-25 to develop automotive-specialized professionals in North Karnataka. With a sanctioned intake of 30 students and a carpet area of 11,000 sq. ft., the department houses dedicated laboratories — Automotive CAD, Automobile Servicing, Automobile Reconditioning, Automobile Scanning, Automotive Electrical & Electronics, and Vehicle Testing. With faculty averaging over 25 years of teaching experience and Ph.D.s across diverse research areas, the department has more than 50 national/international publications and well-qualified technical staff. It plans student SAE activities such as SUPRA, BAJA, EFFICYCLE and GO-KART, and has initiated revenue-generation activities including a motor-vehicle driving school and third-party inspection.

biotechnology.name: Biotechnology
biotechnology.tagline: Craft an exceptional career trajectory in biotechnology
biotechnology.overview: The Department of Biotechnology was established in 2002 and is engaged in effective teaching-learning, basic research and technology-based training and service to society. It offers a 4-year B.E. in Biotechnology (intake 30) and is supported by well-equipped independent laboratories, classrooms, a seminar hall and library. The department has been recognised as an R&D (Ph.D.) Research Centre by VTU Belagavi since 2011, with seven faculty holding Ph.D. degrees and active research in food processing, biofuels technology, bioremediation, fermentation technology and molecular biology. It hosts a Bioenergy Research, Information and Demonstration Centre (BRIDC) in association with KSBDB, GoK and a Food Testing Laboratory supported by KITS, Government of Karnataka, and partners with industry to provide students opportunities for internships and projects.

testimonials.name: Ambika Kurbet
testimonials.quote: My experience at BEC-Bagalkote is great and memorable. The teachers and mentors are really helpful and helped me to improve my academic and interpersonal skills. My life at BEC made me stronger and took me a step ahead towards being an independent woman. I am thankful to all the teachers who supported us and corrected us throughout our bachelors. I loved the infrastructure facility in our college.

testimonials.name: Deepak Bajantri
testimonials.quote: My bachelor degree at Basaveshwar Engg. College-Bagalkote in Biotechnology consisted of many project-based evaluations and faculty connect. The mentors at BEC helped us enhance our academic and interpersonal skills.

testimonials.name: Dr. Rohan Shah
testimonials.quote: I thank my Biotechnology department and its faculty members for encouraging me to think globally and spread my wings. The best thing about this BEC is the cross-culture interaction between students from various parts of the country. The professors here make the institute what it is today. I appreciate the support of my institute for shaping my career and getting me placed in such a big position.

testimonials.name: Shruti Deshpande
testimonials.quote: Department of Biotechnology, Basaveshwar Engg. College-Bagalkote is a place of learning, fun, culture, lore, literature and many such life-preaching activities. Studying at the Basaveshwar Engg. College-Bagalkote brought an added value to my life. It gave me an opportunity to meet different kinds of people and learn a number of things. I have received great support from faculties. I am thankful to the Training & Placement cell for providing a platform to enhance my skills and an opportunity to showcase them.

testimonials.name: Gururaj Patil
testimonials.quote: Think Different — that is one thing that the Department of Biotechnology, Basaveshwar Engg. College-Bagalkote urges in, and to a far extent succeeds in teaching to its students, which invariably helps to achieve what you need. It nourished me and thus gave me an opportunity to define myself.

testimonials.name: Niranjan Nayak
testimonials.quote: I would like to appreciate the Biotechnology Department at Basaveshwar Engineering College for the efforts they made in providing a fair and ample amount of chances to students in every aspect of our academics. The faculty members worked so hard on our overall development and conducted extra classes for us to enhance our technical and interpersonal skills. I loved my time here at BEC.

testimonials.name: Dr. Rahul Metri
testimonials.quote: Basaveshwar Engineering College has been a great contributor to the development of my personality. I have established my leadership, time management and team skills and have also been able to advance these skills to a whole new level. hodMessage.title: HOD’s Message
hodMessage.message: The field of biotechnology stands at the intersection of engineering and technological advancement, encompassing diverse domains such as biopharmaceutical development, industrial applications, and environmental solutions. Central to this discipline is the application of genetic technologies across animal and plant biotechnology, as well as innovations in cell and tissue engineering. The COVID-19 pandemic underscored the critical role of biotechnology, with bio-pharmaceutical companies racing to develop vaccines and therapeutics, illuminating the industry's impact on public health. As of 2023, India emerges as a significant player in the global biotechnology landscape, ranking among the top twelve destinations for biotech innovation and holding the position as the largest biotechnology hub in the Asia Pacific region. The Indian biotechnology sector is valued at over USD 92 billion, with the bio-pharmaceutical industry leading in biosimilars, having the highest number approved in the domestic market. Moreover, the global bio-pharmaceutical market is projected to see remarkable growth, expanding from USD 274.10 billion in 2020 to an anticipated USD 703.28 billion by 2027, indicating a growing recognition of biotechnology's pivotal role in addressing contemporary challenges in healthcare and the environment.

Welcome to Civil Engineering at BEC. Since its inception, the department has been committed to nurturing engineers who design, build, and sustain the infrastructure that shapes society. Our academic and research activities span structural engineering, geotechnical engineering, transportation, environmental engineering, water resources, surveying, and emerging areas in sustainable construction and smart infrastructure.

Our students learn through practical exposure, fieldwork, laboratory experiments, design projects, and industry interaction—because civil engineering is best understood by applying knowledge to real-world challenges. We expect dedication, innovation, and professional integrity, and in return, our faculty provide the mentorship, resources, and opportunities needed for academic and personal growth.

This department is yours to shape with your ideas, commitment, and ambition—and we are here to support you every step of the way.

pos.text: Engineering Knowledge: Apply knowledge of mathematics, natural science, computing, engineering fundamentals and an engineering specialization as specified in WK1 to WK4 respectively to develop solutions to complex engineering problems.

Problem Analysis: Identify, formulate, review research literature and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions with consideration for sustainable development. (WK1 to WK4)

Design/Development of Solutions: Design creative solutions for complex engineering problems and design/develop systems/components/processes to meet identified needs with consideration for the public health and safety, whole-life cost, net zero carbon, culture, society and environment as required. (WK5)

Conduct Investigations of Complex Problems: Conduct investigations of complex engineering problems using research-based knowledge including design of experiments, modelling, analysis and interpretation of data to provide valid conclusions. (WK8)

Engineering Tool Usage: Create, select and apply appropriate techniques, resources and modern engineering and IT tools, including prediction and modelling, recognizing their limitations to solve complex engineering problems. (WK2 and WK6)

The Engineer and The World: Analyze and evaluate societal and environmental aspects while solving complex engineering problems for their impact on sustainability with reference to economy, health, safety, legal framework, culture and environment. (WK1, WK5 and WK7)
Ethics: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics, human values, diversity and inclusion; adhere to national and international laws. (WK9)
Individual and Collaborative Team Work: Function effectively as an individual and as a member or leader in diverse and multi-disciplinary teams.

Communication: Communicate effectively and inclusively within the engineering community and society at large, such as being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, and make effective presentations considering cultural, language and learning differences.

Project Management and Finance: Apply knowledge and understanding of engineering management principles and economic decision-making and apply these to one's own work, as a member and leader in a team, to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.

Life-Long Learning: Recognize the need for and have the preparation and ability for (i) independent and life-long learning, (ii) adaptability to new and emerging technologies and (iii) critical thinking in the broadest context of technological change. (WK8)

wk.text: A systematic, theory-based understanding of the natural sciences applicable to the discipline and awareness of relevant social sciences.

Conceptually-based mathematics, numerical analysis, data analysis, statistics and formal aspects of computer and information science to support detailed analysis and modelling applicable to the discipline.
A systematic, theory-based formulation of engineering fundamentals required in the engineering discipline.

Engineering specialist knowledge that provides theoretical frameworks and bodies of knowledge for the accepted practice areas in the engineering discipline; much is at the forefront of the discipline.

Knowledge, including efficient resource use, environmental impacts, whole-life cost, reuse of resources, net zero carbon and similar concepts, that supports engineering design and operations in a practice area.
Knowledge of engineering practice (technology) in the practice areas in the engineering discipline.

Knowledge of the role of engineering in society and identified issues in engineering practice in the discipline, such as the professional responsibility of an engineer to public safety and sustainable development.
Engagement with selected knowledge in the current research literature of the discipline, and awareness of the power of critical thinking and creative approaches to evaluate emerging issues.

Ethics, inclusive behaviour and conduct. Knowledge of professional ethics, responsibilities and norms of engineering practice. Awareness of the need for diversity by reason of ethnicity, gender, age, physical ability etc. with mutual understanding and respect, and of inclusive attitudes.

customSections.content:
The Department of Civil Engineering offers professional consultancy and testing services to Government Departments, Public Sector Undertakings, Industries, Private Organizations, Architects, Builders, Contractors, and Individual Clients. Supported by experienced faculty members, modern laboratories, and advanced testing equipment, the department delivers reliable, technically sound, and cost-effective engineering solutions in accordance with relevant Indian Standards (IS Codes), IRC, MoRTH, BIS, CPCB, and other applicable specifications.

Our consultancy activities integrate academic expertise with practical engineering applications, ensuring quality, safety, sustainability, and innovation in infrastructure development.

computer-science-and-engg.tagline: A Centre of Excellence in IT Education, Research and Innovation, since 1983.
computer-science-and-engg.overview: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering was established in 1983. It offers B.E. programme in Computer Science and Engineering with an intake of 180 students, along with M.Sc. (Engineering by Research) and Ph.D. programmes. The department has highly qualified and well-experienced faculty committed to imparting quality technical education in IT and research. Its primary objectives include developing innovative skills, enriching academics through quality teaching-learning processes, building student confidence and inculcating entrepreneurial abilities — producing professionals with ethical values and societal concern.
computer-science-and-engg.vision: To be a Centre of Excellence in IT Education, Research and Innovation, crafting competent professionals catering to the needs of society with moral and ethical values.
mission: To produce competent IT professionals committed to lifelong learning.
To promote interdisciplinary research for addressing societal needs.
To inculcate leadership qualities and entrepreneurial abilities with moral and ethical values.
To instill environmental consciousness through holistic teaching-learning processes.

peos.text: Provide a strong educational foundation in Mathematics, Science, Basic Engineering and Computer Science.
Develop proficiency with an ability to solve a wide range of computational problems in industry, government or other work environments.
Inculcate professionalism by infusing leadership qualities, team spirit, effective communication skills, high ethical values and empathy for the needs of society.
Encourage students towards higher studies, research activities and entrepreneurial skills for lifelong learning.

psos.text: Inculcate analytical, logical, programming and managerial abilities.
Apply Software Engineering principles and practices to provide software solutions.
Design and develop computational systems for real-life applications.

wk.text: A systematic, theory-based understanding of the natural sciences applicable to the discipline and awareness of relevant social sciences.

Conceptually-based mathematics, numerical analysis, data analysis, statistics and formal aspects of computer and information science to support detailed analysis and modeling applicable to the discipline.
A systematic, theory-based formulation of engineering fundamentals required in the engineering discipline.

Engineering specialist knowledge that provides theoretical frameworks and bodies of knowledge for the accepted practice areas in the engineering discipline; much is at the forefront of the discipline.

Knowledge, including efficient resource use, environmental impacts, whole-life cost, reuse of resources, net zero carbon and similar concepts, that supports engineering design and operations in a practice area.
Knowledge of engineering practice (technology) in the practice areas in the engineering discipline.

Knowledge of the role of engineering in society and identified issues in engineering practice in the discipline, such as the professional responsibility of an engineer to public safety and sustainable development.
Engagement with selected knowledge in the current research literature of the discipline, and awareness of the power of critical thinking and creative approaches to evaluate emerging issues.

Ethics, inclusive behavior and conduct. Knowledge of professional ethics, responsibilities and norms of engineering practice. Awareness of the need for diversity by reason of ethnicity, gender, age, physical ability etc. with mutual understanding and respect, and of inclusive attitudes.

pos.text: Engineering Knowledge: Apply knowledge of mathematics, natural science, computing, engineering fundamentals and an engineering specialization as specified in WK1 to WK4 respectively to develop solutions to complex engineering problems.

Problem Analysis: Identify, formulate, review research literature and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions with consideration for sustainable development. (WK1 to WK4)

Design/Development of Solutions: Design creative solutions for complex engineering problems and design/develop systems/components/processes to meet identified needs with consideration for the public health and safety, whole-life cost, net zero carbon, culture, society and environment as required. (WK5)

Conduct Investigations of Complex Problems: Conduct investigations of complex engineering problems using research-based knowledge including design of experiments, modelling, analysis and interpretation of data to provide valid conclusions. (WK8)

Engineering Tool Usage: Create, select and apply appropriate techniques, resources and modern engineering and IT tools, including prediction and modelling, recognizing their limitations to solve complex engineering problems. (WK2 and WK6)

The Engineer and The World: Analyze and evaluate societal and environmental aspects while solving complex engineering problems for their impact on sustainability with reference to economy, health, safety, legal framework, culture and environment. (WK1, WK5 and WK7)
Ethics: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics, human values, diversity and inclusion; adhere to national and international laws. (WK9)
Individual and Collaborative Team Work: Function effectively as an individual and as a member or leader in diverse and multi-disciplinary teams.

Communication: Communicate effectively and inclusively within the engineering community and society at large, such as being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, and make effective presentations considering cultural, language and learning differences.

Project Management and Finance: Apply knowledge and understanding of engineering management principles and economic decision-making and apply these to one's own work, as a member and leader in a team, to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.

Life-Long Learning: Recognize the need for and have the preparation and ability for (i) independent and life-long learning, (ii) adaptability to new and emerging technologies and (iii) critical thinking in the broadest context of technological change. (WK8)

electronics-and-communication-engg.overview: The Department of Electronics and Communication (E&C) Engineering was established in 1985. It offers an undergraduate programme in Electronics and Communication Engineering along with Ph.D. programmes in cutting-edge areas such as VLSI Design, Digital Signal Processing, Wireless Networking, MEMS and Speech Signal Processing. Recognised as a Quality Improvement Programme (QIP) centre by the Government of India, the department has a strong legacy in research and development — particularly in communications, signal processing, microelectronics and RF/photonics. It hosts well-equipped laboratories spanning digital electronics, advanced digital communication, microwave communication, microprocessors and microcontrollers, and computer networks, along with an exclusive computing facility running industry-standard tools such as CADENCE VLSI, ECAD and Verilog simulation/synthesis packages. The department regularly organises seminars, workshops and training programmes under initiatives like TEQIP, ACME and AICTE, and has executed several AICTE-sponsored projects to strengthen its laboratory and research capabilities.

electrical-and-electronics-engg.overview: Electrical and Electronics Engineering department (EEED) was started with the inception of the college in the year 1963. The department offers graduate, research programs. It has well equipped laboratories with state-of-art equipment. The students excel in academics under the constant guidance of qualified and dedicated staff. The faculty and student development programs are regularly organized. The graduating students are well placed in industry as well as in academia through campus placements and direct recruitment. Department has specialized faculty in Power Systems, Machines, Drives and Power Electronics, Renewable Energy Sources, Signal Processing, HVDC and FACTS, Power and Energy Systems. The Department has well-established Electrical Machines, High Voltage Engineering, Power System, Microcontrollers and Power System Protection laboratories. The Software packages include AutoCAD, MATLAB, Mi-power, Windographer and Code Composer Studio. The department is rendering dedicated service to the Electrical and Electronics community. It is accredited by NBA and a recognized Research Center of Visveswaraya Technological University Belgaum. It offers, Ph.D. and M.Sc. Engg. by research. At present eight research scholars are persuing Ph.D. in the department. Over the years the department has received 150+ lakhs R&D grants and produced 16+ Ph.Ds, 75+ M.Techs and 90+ technical publications. Three new research labs in the area of Renewable Energy , SCADA and FPGA based Machine drives are established under the financial support from VGST, Govt of Karnataka and TEQIP grants of World Bank. The department is having MoUs with eight organization, under which students and faculty are excelling and working with latest projects in the area of electrical engineering.

pos.text: Engineering Knowledge: Apply knowledge of mathematics, natural science, computing, engineering fundamentals and an engineering specialization as specified in WK1 to WK4 respectively to develop solutions to complex engineering problems.

Problem Analysis: Identify, formulate, review research literature and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions with consideration for sustainable development. (WK1 to WK4)

Design/Development of Solutions: Design creative solutions for complex engineering problems and design/develop systems/components/processes to meet identified needs with consideration for the public health and safety, whole-life cost, net zero carbon, culture, society and environment as required. (WK5)

Conduct Investigations of Complex Problems: Conduct investigations of complex engineering problems using research-based knowledge including design of experiments, modelling, analysis and interpretation of data to provide valid conclusions. (WK8)

Engineering Tool Usage: Create, select and apply appropriate techniques, resources and modern engineering and IT tools, including prediction and modelling, recognizing their limitations to solve complex engineering problems. (WK2 and WK6)

The Engineer and The World: Analyze and evaluate societal and environmental aspects while solving complex engineering problems for their impact on sustainability with reference to economy, health, safety, legal framework, culture and environment. (WK1, WK5 and WK7)
Ethics: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics, human values, diversity and inclusion; adhere to national and international laws. (WK9)
Individual and Collaborative Team Work: Function effectively as an individual and as a member or leader in diverse and multi-disciplinary teams.

Communication: Communicate effectively and inclusively within the engineering community and society at large, such as being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, and make effective presentations considering cultural, language and learning differences.

Project Management and Finance: Apply knowledge and understanding of engineering management principles and economic decision-making and apply these to one's own work, as a member and leader in a team, to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.

Life-Long Learning: Recognize the need for and have the preparation and ability for (i) independent and life-long learning, (ii) adaptability to new and emerging technologies and (iii) critical thinking in the broadest context of technological change. (WK8)

wk.text: A systematic, theory-based understanding of the natural sciences applicable to the discipline and awareness of relevant social sciences.

Conceptually-based mathematics, numerical analysis, data analysis, statistics and formal aspects of computer and information science to support detailed analysis and modelling applicable to the discipline.
A systematic, theory-based formulation of engineering fundamentals required in the engineering discipline.

Engineering specialist knowledge that provides theoretical frameworks and bodies of knowledge for the accepted practice areas in the engineering discipline; much is at the forefront of the discipline.

Knowledge, including efficient resource use, environmental impacts, whole-life cost, reuse of resources, net zero carbon and similar concepts, that supports engineering design and operations in a practice area.
Knowledge of engineering practice (technology) in the practice areas in the engineering discipline.

Knowledge of the role of engineering in society and identified issues in engineering practice in the discipline, such as the professional responsibility of an engineer to public safety and sustainable development.
Engagement with selected knowledge in the current research literature of the discipline, and awareness of the power of critical thinking and creative approaches to evaluate emerging issues.

Ethics, inclusive behaviour and conduct. Knowledge of professional ethics, responsibilities and norms of engineering practice. Awareness of the need for diversity by reason of ethnicity, gender, age, physical ability etc. with mutual understanding and respect, and of inclusive attitudes.

electronics-and-computer-engg.name: Electronics and Computer Engineering
electronics-and-computer-engg.tagline: An interdisciplinary department blending electronics engineering and computer science to design, develop and integrate innovative technologies.
electronics-and-computer-engg.overview: Electronics and Computer Engineering blends electronics engineering with computer science to design, develop and integrate innovative technologies across hardware, software and IT. Established in the academic year 2024-25, the department offers a 4-year B.E. programme with an intake of 60 students, taught by highly qualified faculty whose average teaching experience is 27 years. It is housed in a spacious new building with well-equipped VLSI, IoT, and computer laboratories of more than 60 computers, faculty rooms and a department office, all served by pervasive high-quality wired and Wi-Fi networks. The department aims to impart engineering education that meets the needs of society, industry and research, developing professionals with ethical values and societal concern who are equipped for both electronics/electrical industries and software companies.
electronics-and-computer-engg.about:
Welcome to the Department of Electronics and Computer Engineering (ECS) at Basaveshwar Engineering College, Bagalkote—a place where innovation meets technology and ideas are transformed into impactful solutions.

Established in the academic year 2024-25, the Department of Electronics and Computer Engineering offers a unique interdisciplinary program that combines the strengths of Electronics Engineering with the rapidly evolving world of Computer Science. As industries increasingly seek engineers who can seamlessly integrate hardware and software, our program equips students with the knowledge and practical skills needed to excel in this dynamic landscape.

Electronics and Computer Engineering—where hardware meets intelligence, software drives innovation, and your future begins.
electronics-and-computer-engg.vision: To be recognized as a Center of Excellence for Electronics and Computer Engineering education and research, developing competent professionals with moral and ethical values.
mission: Develop professionals with strong fundamentals, technical skills, committed to life-long learning.
Create an environment for interdisciplinary research by collaborating with industries and institutes of higher learning.
Imbibe high moral and ethical values.

peos.text: Apply knowledge of electronics and computing to design and develop intelligent products or systems, including IoT, robotics, and AI-based applications, addressing societal and industrial needs.
Develop expertise in designing, analyzing, and implementing electronic circuits, embedded systems, and signal processing applications to meet the needs of real-world challenges.
Impart proficiency in programming languages, software development, and modern computational tools to create innovative solutions for complex engineering problems.
Adapt to emerging technologies in electronics and computer engineering by engaging in continuous learning and contributing to sustainable and ethical technological advancements.

psos.text: Demonstrate the ability to design, develop a product/system by integrating concepts from electronics and computer engineering to solve real-world problems.

Inculcate the expertise in modern technologies such as Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, IoT, and Cyber-Physical Systems, and apply them to create innovative and sustainable engineering solutions.

pos.text: Engineering Knowledge: Apply knowledge of mathematics, natural science, computing, engineering fundamentals and an engineering specialization as specified in WK1 to WK4 respectively to develop to the solution of complex engineering problems.

Problem Analysis: Identify, formulate, review research literature and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions with consideration for sustainable development. (WK1 to WK4)

Design/Development of Solutions: Design creative solutions for complex engineering problems and design/develop systems/components/processes to meet identified needs with consideration for the public health and safety, whole-life cost, net zero carbon, culture, society and environment as required. (WK5)

Conduct Investigations of Complex Problems: Conduct investigations of complex engineering problems using research-based knowledge including design of experiments, modelling, analysis & interpretation of data to provide valid conclusions. (WK8).

Engineering Tool Usage: Create, select and apply appropriate techniques, resources and modern engineering & IT tools, including prediction and modelling recognizing their limitations to solve complex engineering problems. (WK2 and WK6)

The Engineer and The World: Analyze and evaluate societal and environmental aspects while solving complex engineering problems for its impact on sustainability with reference to economy, health, safety, legal framework, culture and environment. (WK1, WK5 and WK7).
Ethics: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics, human values, diversity and inclusion; adhere to national & international laws. (WK9)
Individual and Collaborative Team work: Function effectively as an individual and as a member or leader in diverse/multi-disciplinary teams.

Communication: Communicate effectively and inclusively within the engineering community and society at large, such as being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations considering cultural, language and learning differences

Project Management and Finance: Apply knowledge and understanding of engineering management principles and economic decision-making and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team and to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.

Life-Long Learning: Recognize the need for and have the preparation and ability for i) independent and life-long learning ii) adaptability to new and emerging technologies and iii) critical thinking in the broadest context of technological change. (WK8)

wk.text: A systematic, theory-based understanding of the natural sciences applicable to the discipline and awareness of relevant social sciences.

Conceptually-based mathematics, numerical analysis, data analysis, statistics and formal aspects of computer and information science to support detailed analysis and modelling applicable to the discipline.
A systematic, theory-based formulation of engineering fundamentals required in the engineering discipline.

Engineering specialist knowledge that provides theoretical frameworks and bodies of knowledge for the accepted practice areas in the engineering discipline; much is at the forefront of the discipline.

Knowledge, including efficient resource use, environmental impacts, whole- life cost, reuse of resources, net zero carbon, and similar concepts, that supports engineering design and operations in a practice area.
Knowledge of engineering practice (technology) in the practice areas in the engineering discipline.

Knowledge of the role of engineering in society and identified issues in engineering practice in the discipline, such as the professional responsibility of an engineer to public safety and sustainable development.
Engagement with selected knowledge in the current research literature of the discipline, awareness of the power of critical thinking and creative approaches to evaluate emerging issues.

Ethics, inclusive behavior and conduct. Knowledge of professional ethics, responsibilities, and norms of engineering practice. Awareness of the need for diversity by reason of ethnicity, gender, age, physical ability etc. with mutual understanding and respect, and of inclusive attitudes.

These activities empower students to bridge the gap between theory and practice, foster innovation, and prepare them for the rapidly evolving world of technology. Guided by dedicated faculty mentors and supported by state-of-the-art facilities, our students continuously strive for excellence and make meaningful contributions to engineering and society. At the Department of Electronics and Computer Engineering, we believe that every aspiring engineer has the potential to become an outstanding technologist. Outstanding Techies celebrates this journey of learning, innovation, and excellence, inspiring students to dream bigger, create smarter, and lead the future.

industrial-and-production-engg.name: Industrial & Production Engineering
industrial-and-production-engg.tagline: A centre of excellence in Industrial and Production Engineering education, research and practice, shaping globally competent leaders for manufacturing and service industries.
industrial-and-production-engg.overview: The Department of Industrial & Production Engineering was established in 1984 with an initial intake of 30 students. It prepares leaders capable of managing manufacturing and service-industry operations across the two domains of Industrial Engineering and Production Engineering. Students gain exposure to modern manufacturing technologies including CAD/CAM, CAE, FMS, CIM and additive manufacturing, alongside management concepts taught through practical case studies, supported by fully doctorate-qualified faculty, well-equipped laboratories and experienced technical staff. The department has been a recognised research centre since 2008, with 13 candidates awarded Ph.D. to date.
industrial-and-production-engg.about: Industrial and Production Engineering is a multidisciplinary field that focuses on the design, development, optimization, and management of manufacturing and service systems to achieve higher productivity, quality, sustainability, and operational excellence. The discipline integrates engineering principles with management sciences, data-driven decision-making, and digital technologies to address complex industrial challenges. Modern Industrial and Production Engineering encompasses advanced concepts such as Industry 4.0, Smart Manufacturing, the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Digital Twins, Data Analytics, Cloud Manufacturing, Industrial Robotics, Automation, Cyber-Physical Systems, and Additive Manufacturing. It emphasizes the effective application of computer-aided engineering tools, simulation, optimization techniques, supply chain management, quality engineering, lean manufacturing, sustainability, and advanced production planning to enhance organizational performance. By combining technical expertise with leadership, innovation, and problem-solving skills, Industrial and Production Engineering prepares professionals to develop intelligent, resilient, and sustainable industrial systems that meet the evolving demands of global manufacturing and service industries.

To develop professional competence in design, manufacturing, maintenance, quality, and computational aspects of products and services, enabling graduates to contribute effectively as industrial engineers and managers.
To nurture lifelong learning, ethical practice, creativity, communication, and entrepreneurial ability, with a strong multidisciplinary outlook for continuous professional growth.

pos.text: Engineering Knowledge: Apply knowledge of mathematics, natural science, computing, engineering fundamentals and an engineering specialization as specified in WK1 to WK4 respectively to develop to the solution of complex engineering problems.

information-science-and-engg.overview: The Department of Information Science and Engineering was established in 1999 and offers a 4-year B.E. programme in Information Science and Engineering with a sanctioned intake of 180. Backed by qualified faculty and well-equipped computing laboratories, the department trains students in information and communication technologies, software engineering and emerging computing domains. It runs a recognised Research Centre (established 2020) with active research in image processing and pattern recognition, wireless sensor and ubiquitous networks, vehicular ad-hoc networks, IoT and cloud computing, and data mining and machine/deep learning. The B.E. programme has been accredited by the NBA, and the department maintains strong industry linkages, internships and a vibrant student association.

hodMessage.message: Welcome to the Department of Information Science and Engineering at Basaveshwar Engineering College. With dedicated and experienced faculty members, state-of-the-art laboratories, industry collaborations, and a research-oriented environment, we encourage the students to explore emerging technologies and develop innovative solutions to real-world challenges. The department also motivates students to actively participate in co-curricular and extracurricular activities, fostering their overall personality development and preparing them to become competent, ethical, and socially responsible professionals.

mechanical-engg.name: Mechanical Engineering
mechanical-engg.tagline: Excelling in mechanical engineering education, research and innovation for sustainable development.
mechanical-engg.overview: Established in 1963, the Department of Mechanical Engineering is one of the oldest and largest departments of Basaveshwar Engineering College, Bagalkote. The department offers a B.E. programme with an annual intake of 120 students and has a recognized Research and Development Centre offering M.Sc. (Engg.) and Ph.D. programmes under VTU, Belagavi. It is also a recognized QIP Centre of AICTE, Government of India. The B.E. programme is NBA-accredited under the Tier-I framework aligned with the Washington Accord up to June 2028. Faculty members have successfully completed sponsored research projects worth over Rs. 300 lakhs, published over 500 research papers along with books and book chapters and guided 66 research scholars to Ph.D. degrees. Supported by Government funding agencies such as DRDO, DST, CSIR, NRB and VGST, the department provides excellent research facilities, strong industry interaction, industrial exposure and career opportunities in both core and IT sectors.

peos.text: The Mechanical Engineering students should be able to engage in the design and to develop the components and equipments in the field of mechanical engineering industries and other allied industries.

The graduates should be able to apply the knowledge of mechanical engineering to solve problems of social relevance and pursue higher education studies and research in the field of materials science, machine design, manufacturing and thermal/fluid engineering.
The graduates will work effectively as individuals and as team members in interdisciplinary projects.
The graduates should be able to engage in lifelong learning, to become an entrepreneur, apply ethics and adapt to changing professional and societal requirements.

Identify, formulate, and implement solutions to real-world mechanical engineering problems by integrating knowledge from multidisciplinary domains, including IoT and AI, while upholding ethical standards and effective communication within diverse teams.

wk.text: A systematic, theory-based understanding of the natural sciences applicable to the discipline and awareness of relevant social sciences.

Conceptually-based mathematics, numerical analysis, data analysis, statistics and formal aspects of computer and information science to support detailed analysis and modelling applicable to the discipline.
A systematic, theory-based formulation of engineering fundamentals required in the engineering discipline.

Engineering specialist knowledge that provides theoretical frameworks and bodies of knowledge for the accepted practice areas in the engineering discipline; much is at the forefront of the discipline.

Knowledge, including efficient resource use, environmental impacts, whole-life cost, re-use of resources, net zero carbon, and similar concepts, that supports engineering design and operations in a practice area.
Knowledge of engineering practice (technology) in the practice areas in the engineering discipline.

Knowledge of the role of engineering in society and identified issues in engineering practice in the discipline, such as the professional responsibility of an engineer to public safety and sustainable development.
Engagement with selected knowledge in the current research literature of the discipline, awareness of the power of critical thinking and creative approaches to evaluate emerging issues.

Ethics, inclusive behavior and conduct. Knowledge of professional ethics, responsibilities, and norms of engineering practice. Awareness of the need for diversity by reason of ethnicity, gender, age, physical ability etc. with mutual understanding and respect, and of inclusive attitudes.

pos.text: Engineering Knowledge: Apply knowledge of mathematics, natural science, computing, engineering fundamentals and an engineering specialization as specified in WK1 to WK4 respectively to develop to the solution of complex engineering problems.

Problem Analysis: Identify, formulate, review research literature and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions with consideration for sustainable development (WK1 to WK4).

Design/Development of Solutions: Design creative solutions for complex engineering problems and design/develop systems/components/processes to meet identified needs with consideration for the public health and safety, whole-life cost, net zero carbon, culture, society and environment as required (WK5).

Conduct Investigations of Complex Problems: Conduct investigations of complex engineering problems using research-based knowledge including design of experiments, modelling, analysis & interpretation of data to provide valid conclusions (WK8).

Engineering Tool Usage: Create, select and apply appropriate techniques, resources and modern engineering & IT tools, including prediction and modelling recognizing their limitations to solve complex engineering problems (WK2 and WK6).

The Engineer and The World: Analyze and evaluate societal and environmental aspects while solving complex engineering problems for its impact on sustainability with reference to economy, health, safety, legal framework, culture and environment (WK1, WK5, and WK7).
Ethics: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics, human values, diversity and inclusion; adhere to national & international laws (WK9).
Individual and Collaborative Team work: Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse/multi-disciplinary teams.

Communication: Communicate effectively and inclusively within the engineering community and society at large, such as being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations considering cultural, language, and learning differences.

Project Management and Finance: Apply knowledge and understanding of engineering management principles and economic decision-making and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, and to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.

Life-Long Learning: Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability for i) independent and life-long learning ii) adaptability to new and emerging technologies and iii) critical thinking in the broadest context of technological change (WK8).

The Department of Chemistry serves as a crucial stepping stone in shaping young minds for successful engineering careers. The courses offered during the first year provide a strong scientific and analytical foundation, enabling students to understand core engineering concepts and develop the problem-solving skills essential for their future studies.

The department offers courses that emphasize the application of basic sciences to engineering, fostering innovation, critical thinking, and a multidisciplinary approach to learning. These courses help students build a solid understanding of fundamental principles while preparing them to meet the challenges of modern engineering and technology.

The department is supported by highly qualified, experienced, and dedicated faculty members who strive to create an engaging and dynamic learning environment. Through effective teaching methodologies and continuous mentoring, faculty members inspire students to achieve academic excellence and adapt successfully to the engineering curriculum.

Beyond academics, students are encouraged to actively participate in various co-curricular and extracurricular activities that contribute to their overall personality development. The department places strong emphasis on practical learning, enabling students to acquire hands-on experience and develop the skills required for their professional growth.

We are committed to providing a healthy, supportive, and student-friendly atmosphere that nurtures confidence, creativity, leadership, and lifelong learning. The Department of Chemistry aims to equip students with the knowledge, skills, and values necessary to excel in their chosen engineering disciplines and become responsible professionals and citizens.
chemistry.about: The Department of Chemistry serves as a foundational pillar in engineering education by imparting essential scientific knowledge and fostering analytical and problem-solving skills among undergraduate students. The department is committed to providing quality education through an outcome-based teaching–learning process that aligns with the vision and mission of the institution and supports the holistic development of future engineers.
chemistry.vision: To be recognized as a premier technical institute committed to developing exemplary professionals, offering research-based innovative solutions and inspiring inventions for holistic socio-economic development.
mission: Pursue excellence through student-centric, dynamic teaching-learning processes, encouraging freedom of inquiry and openness to change.
Carry out innovative, cutting-edge research and transfer technology for industrial and societal needs.
Imbibe moral and ethical values and develop compassionate human professionals.
highlights: Delivers stream-wise Applied Chemistry courses tailored to the CSE, EEE, Civil and Mechanical engineering streams of the first-year curriculum.
Integrated theory-and-laboratory courses (3:0:2:0) covering energy systems, corrosion science, polymers, nanomaterials, sensors, display systems and e-waste management.
Active faculty research in biofuel/biodiesel production from non-edible oils and in synthesis and characterization of ferrite nanomaterials, with publications in international journals.
Well-equipped analytical chemistry laboratory with colorimeters, pH meters, potentiometers and conductometers supporting practical coursework.

humanities.name: Humanities & Social Sciences
humanities.tagline: An interdisciplinary department shaping engineers into legally, linguistically, socially and ethically conscious individuals.
humanities.overview: The Department of Humanities and Social Sciences, started in 2006, is an interdisciplinary department of Basaveshwar Engineering College, Bagalkote, that seeks to make technologists legally, linguistically, socially and ethically conscious individuals. Over the years, various subjects of humanities and social sciences have been introduced to widen the intellectual horizon of technical students. Today, the department functions at the intersections of communication, languages, Constitution of India, Intellectual Property Rights, Soft Skills, Universal Human Values, Scientific Foundations of Health and Innovation and Design Thinking. It focuses on students' inner character so that they contribute to building a value-based society.
humanities.vision: To be unique and versatile unit of the institution, to promote the constitutional values with language proficiency, ethics, scientific temper and humanism, inculcating practices of good health and wellness, spirit of nationality among engineering graduates.
mission: Develop globally competent professionals for future talent requirements.
Sharpening practical skills by providing value-based education.
Imbibe moral and ethical values and foster ecological and environmental consciousness.
Develop multi-tasking talent in graduates.
highlights: Interdisciplinary department established in 2006, serving all engineering programmes of the college.

Offers core, mandatory and elective courses in Constitution of India, Intellectual Property Rights, Communicative English, Kannada (Samskruthika and Balake), Soft Skills, Universal Human Values, Scientific Foundations of Health, and Innovation and Design Thinking.
A well-established Language Laboratory supported by duly qualified faculty.
Best practices include in-classroom online quizzes after each topic and student seminars with PPT presentations to build communication skills and stage confidence.

labs.name: Language Laboratory — ORELL Digital Language Lab (DLL)
labs.description: The department's Language Laboratory runs the ORELL Digital Language Lab (DLL), a software-driven, technology-enabled environment designed to enhance students' proficiency in English and other languages through interactive, audio-visual and activity-based learning. It develops communication skills, pronunciation, vocabulary, grammar and listening comprehension, strengthening all four Listening, Speaking, Reading and Writing (LSRW) skills. Sessions are conducted through live demonstrations of the software followed by interactive activities based on audio-visual lectures on Communicative English, improving students' listening and speaking skills, building confidence and creating awareness of the importance of practising advanced English vocabulary for effective communication. For students, it improves pronunciation and communication, enhances listening comprehension and speaking confidence, develops correct grammar usage, encourages self-paced independent learning and provides immediate feedback to improve language accuracy.
features: Interactive lessons with audio, video, animations and exercises
Listening, Speaking, Reading and Writing (LSRW) skill development
Speech recording and playback for self-assessment and teacher evaluation
Vocabulary and grammar enhancement through structured activities
Real-time teacher monitoring and control of student activities
Individual, pair and group learning modes
Progress tracking, performance assessment and report generation

pg/structural-engg.tagline: A two-year postgraduate programme of the Department of Civil Engineering, focused on analysis, design and research in structural engineering.
pg/structural-engg.overview: The Civil Engineering Department is one of the pioneering departments of the college, established at its inception in 1963. The M.Tech. in Structural Engineering, with an intake of 18, provides postgraduate education in structural analysis and design supported by advanced laboratory facilities and research recognition from VTU and AICTE. Admissions are offered through PGCET/GATE and the Quality Improvement Programme (QIP), and the curriculum emphasises fundamental principles and creative problem-solving.
pg/structural-engg.vision: To be a center of excellence of higher learning and research in civil engineering encompassing ethical, environmental and economical aspects of the society.
mission: Prepare globally competent engineers through dynamic teaching-learning and research processes.
Provide knowledge base and consultancy services to the community in Civil Engineering areas.

peos.text: Graduates of the programme will become effective Structural engineers in government, industry, or other organizations, designing, improving and implementing efficient, sustainable Structural engineering practices.

Graduates of the programme will provide solutions to Structural engineering problems that account for economical, societal and ethical standards, both as individuals and in team environments, by applying acquired engineering knowledge.
Graduates of the programme will continue their lifelong learning to remain effective professionals and to maintain and enhance technical and professional growth.

highlights: M.Tech. in Structural Engineering with an intake of 18.
AICTE recognized, NAAC accredited and VTU affiliated.
State-of-the-art Structural Engineering laboratory with advanced testing equipment (actuator, loading frames, compression machines).
Computational facilities with ANSYS, ETABS, STAAD and AutoCAD.
Faculty engaged in research and consultancy activities.

mca.tagline: Educate and empower students for the IT profession with techno-social values.
mca.overview: The MCA programme is a two-year course offered within the autonomous framework granted to the college by VTU and UGC in 2007. It has well-equipped laboratories with state-of-the-art equipment and highly qualified, well-experienced faculty committed to imparting quality technical education in IT and research. Our curriculum, aligned with the latest technological advancements, gives students strong foundations in programming, software engineering, artificial intelligence, data science, cloud computing, web technologies, cybersecurity and emerging computing domains. Along with technical knowledge, we emphasise critical thinking, problem-solving, innovation, ethical values, teamwork, leadership, research and lifelong learning.
mca.vision: To be a centre of excellence in the field of Computer Applications, to educate and empower students for the IT profession with techno-social values.
mission: Impart quality education through an effective teaching–learning process.

hodMessage.message: We believe that education is not merely about earning a degree but about building character, developing leadership qualities and strong technical skills to solve real-world problems, and creating responsible professionals who contribute positively to society. We encourage every student to dream big, work hard, embrace continuous learning and uphold the values of integrity, discipline and social responsibility. Our experienced and dedicated faculty are committed to providing quality education through outcome-based teaching, practical laboratory sessions, project-based learning, industry interactions, internships, technical workshops, seminars and value-added certification programmes. We continuously encourage students to participate in research, innovation, hackathons, coding competitions and professional activities that enhance their technical expertise and employability. We maintain strong interactions with industry and alumni to ensure our students remain industry-ready and globally competitive. I warmly invite aspiring students, parents, recruiters and stakeholders to explore the opportunities offered by our department — together, let us embark on a journey of learning, innovation and excellence.

peos.text: Have a strong foundation and the ability to apply knowledge of computer science and applications, and mathematics, to analyse, design and implement IT solutions to real-life problems.
Have a comprehensive background to practise software engineering principles across domains that require software architecture, design, development and testing practices.
Have an understanding of the professional and ethical obligations of a software engineer towards society and the need for lifelong learning.

psos.text: Apply computer science and applications knowledge to analyse, design and develop computing solutions using modern languages, environments and platforms that solve simple to complex real-time problems.

Anticipate the changing direction of computational technology, evaluate it, and communicate its likely utility for building software systems that perform tasks related to industry, research and education.
Inculcate the knowledge of computer applications and management principles to manage IT projects effectively and create an innovative career path.

pos.text: Foundation Knowledge: Apply knowledge of mathematics, programming logic and coding fundamentals for solution architecture and problem solving.
Problem Analysis: Identify, review, formulate and analyse problems, primarily focusing on customer requirements, using critical-thinking frameworks.

Development of Solutions: Design, develop and investigate problems with an innovative approach for solutions incorporating ESG (Environmental, Social and Governance) and SDG (Sustainable Development Goals).
Modern Tool Usage: Select, adapt and apply modern computational tools such as algorithm development, with an understanding of limitations including human biases.
Individual and Teamwork: Function and communicate effectively as an individual or as a team leader in diverse and multidisciplinary groups, using methodologies such as Agile.
Project Management and Finance: Use principles of project management such as scheduling and work-breakdown structure, and be conversant with principles of finance for profitable project management.
Ethics: Commit to professional ethics in managing software projects with financial aspects; learn to use new technologies for cybersecurity and protect customers from malware.
Life-long Learning: Demonstrate change-management skills and the ability to learn and adapt to contemporary technologies and evolving ways of working.

hodMessage.message:
Welcome to the Department of Master of Business Administration (MBA), Basaveshwar Engineering College, Bagalkot.

Our MBA program is committed to nurturing competent, ethical, and innovative management professionals who can excel in today's dynamic global business environment. We strive to provide a balanced blend of academic excellence, industry exposure, research orientation, and value-based education that empowers students to become future-ready leaders and entrepreneurs.

The department adopts a student-centric approach to learning through case studies, experiential learning, live projects, internships, industry interactions, seminars, workshops, certification programs, and management fests. Our experienced faculty members are dedicated to developing students' analytical, decision-making, communication, leadership, and entrepreneurial skills.

We believe that management education extends beyond classrooms. Therefore, we encourage students to actively participate in co-curricular and extracurricular activities, social initiatives, innovation, and lifelong learning. Strong industry collaborations and placement support further ensure that our graduates are well-prepared to meet the evolving demands of organizations.

At Basaveshwar Engineering College, we are committed to creating an environment that fosters integrity, professionalism, innovation, and social responsibility. We invite aspiring students, parents, alumni, recruiters, and other stakeholders to explore the opportunities offered by our department and join us in our pursuit of excellence in management education.

I warmly welcome you to the Department of MBA and wish you a rewarding and successful academic journey.

mba.overview: The Department of Management Studies was established at Basaveshwar Engineering College in 2009 to impart quality management education. It offers a two-year full-time MBA programme with an intake of 60 students spread over four semesters. The programme is autonomous, affiliated to VTU, Belagavi and approved by AICTE, New Delhi. The department is equipped with the necessary infrastructure, and its faculty are drawn from different specializations with varied experience. Practical labs such as a Communication Lab and a Business Analytics Lab give students hands-on exposure to the presentation, communication, technical and analytical skills required of today's and tomorrow's managers.

testimonials.name: Chandulingappa H
testimonials.quote: Being a part of new beginnings is always special and so is my journey in MBA as it kicked off along with BEC DOMS “Founders Batch” of MBA. Looking back, I can certainly say that DOMS was the most important milestone in shaping my career. MBA provides an innovative course design, best-in-class faculty from industry and academics. Throughout the academic sessions, I was challenged to discover capabilities that I never knew I had. Along with academics, the Department focuses on personality development which helped me build a rewarding career.

testimonials.name: Anusha Aravepalli
testimonials.quote: I chose the MBA course at BEC DOMS to help me get closer to my dreams. Throughout my course, I had countless opportunities to develop analytical skills, leadership, and proactive thinking through various course-related activities. Department of Management Studies has the best faculty team who provide 360-degree support to students. I thank all my faculty members and friends for the amazing journey at BEC DOMS.

testimonials.name: Vishwanath Ulligaddi
testimonials.quote: Today, I am working with Asian Paints. When I look back at the 10+ years of my life after BEC DOMS, I feel honored to be a part of an institution that helped me become the confident professional that I am today. When the opportunity comes calling, you ought to keep the door open. At DOMS, not only were we made aware to keep the doors open, we were taught to build new ones for ourselves.

testimonials.name: Mallikarjun D Ghatawalimath
testimonials.quote: DOMS waters the seed deeply buried in you, protects you and helps you grow. A great amount of gratitude to the wonderful professors of BEC DOMS who hold brilliant industry and academic experience. The assignment & assessment mechanism is top-notch. It becomes needless to voice out — if you are looking for an institution to enhance knowledge and to be competent in the current challenging world, then DOMS is the right place!

testimonials.name: Shruti Talikoti
testimonials.quote: I am working as a Senior Analyst in EY and would profoundly like to share that “Genesis” is an important word, and I must say the Department of Management Studies, Basaveshwar Engineering College (BEC-DOMS) is one place where it all started for me. Graduation was just a certificate, but the journey that made us capable of going that one extra mile can’t be summarized in a few words. Apart from lecture rooms or any infrastructure we could ask for, BEC’s vision to enable its students with industry-level capabilities made the difference. It’s been 10 years since I have been working in an industry where knowledge and discipline towards the profession is an essence. I extend my heartfelt thanks to my faculty for their selfless efforts.

testimonials.name: Harun M. Kudachi
testimonials.organization: Online Instruments India Pvt. Ltd, Bengaluru
testimonials.quote: BEC DOMS gave me so many opportunities to learn, not just academically but experientially. The knowledge, acumen and confidence I gained in the Department of Management Studies, BEC, gave me wings to fly.

testimonials.name: Vijalakshmi Hiremath
testimonials.quote: It’s an immense pleasure to count myself as an alumni of BEC DOMS. I learnt and gained extensive experiences which helped throughout my studies in all my thick and thin. The knowledge and discipline we get from BEC DOMS is phenomenal, which helps you to succeed in all endeavors. And I’m sure it will help me in my future life. I owe a huge vote of thanks to every opportunity given to me to explore my personality and potential at the Department of Management Studies, Basaveshwar Engineering College.

testimonials.name: Geeta Benal

A system that motivates you to form an everlasting bond with your college. BEC DOMS is truly a place that prepares you for the real world.
